root_cause_analysis: The Tamil carousel generation pipeline encountered a critical failure during the visual inspection phase. The visual auditing engine returned a zero score and marked the inspection as failed because the visual audit service was unavailable or unable to render and evaluate the generated slides (slide_count_audited: 2). As per engine.py line 174, this triggers an immediate ValueError, halting the pipeline to prevent unverified content from publication.
actionable_instructions: Verify the operational status and connectivity of the visual auditing/rendering service.
Inspect the slide generation output directory for slide 1 and slide 2 to check for rendering corruptions or missing assets.
Rerun the pipeline in dry-run mode or apply an override query once the visual audit dependency is restored.
